title: Verify: Manifest schema unit tests
description: Unit tests for schema accept and reject cases.
acceptance_criteria: Bad dimensions, type, origin and bounds fail

steps.action: Create tests importing assetSchema from ../src/assets/manifest/schema: (1) image {id:'bookshelf',path:'objects/bookshelf.png',type:'image',dimensions:{width:32,height:64},origin:{x:0.5,y:1},interactionBounds:{x:0,y:0,width:32,height:64}} parses success; (2) spritesheet with frames {frameWidth:16,frameHeight:16,frameCount:4}, dimensions 64x16 and animations {idle:{frames:[0,1],frameRate:4}} succeeds; (3) spritesheet lacking frames fails; (4) dimensions width 0 fails; (5) type 'video' fails; (6) origin.x 1.5 fails; (7) bounds width -1 fails
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestSchema.test.ts
